items.title: Define ClaimAdmissibilityPack and related adapter contract types
items.context: Create a typed contract matching docs/requirements/decisions/claim-admissibility-adapter-pack-framework.md without adding execution behavior.
items.userSees: Smoke output includes: "pack contract exposes code-runtime pack".

happy.desc: The code-runtime pack descriptor satisfies the ClaimAdmissibilityPack contract.

edge.desc: Optional benchmark harness definitions can be absent without invalidating a pack.

adversarial.desc: The pack contract has no productionDone or scientific-truth minting field.

verificationEvidence.note: Focused smoke proves the built-in code-runtime pack descriptor validates under the ClaimAdmissibilityPack contract and is listed/resolved by the default registry.
Focused smoke asserts the code-runtime pack has no benchmarkHarnesses property and remains valid, proving benchmark harness definitions are optional for M1.

Focused smoke checks the pack JSON excludes forbidden production/scientific/hardware/solver/authority claim fields; follow-up commit also tightened claim boundary completion/external gate flags to literal false.

items.title: Implement a read-only pack registry with fail-closed validation
items.context: Registry should list enabled packs, resolve by id, reject duplicate ids/schema ids/artifact kinds/aliases/claim ids, and never create new proof storage.
items.userSees: Smoke output includes: "duplicate pack ids: BLOCK" and "duplicate artifact aliases: BLOCK".

happy.desc: Default registry lists the built-in code-runtime pack and resolves it by id.

edge.desc: Unknown pack ids resolve to a deterministic not-found result instead of throwing.

adversarial.desc: Duplicate pack ids, schema ids, artifact kinds, aliases, and claim ids are rejected deterministically.

items.title: Expose the pack framework through the admissibility compatibility entrypoint
items.context: Re-export the framework from the existing evidence/admissibility index so future packs do not import a private duplicate registry.
items.userSees: Smoke output includes: "compat entrypoint exports pack registry".

happy.desc: Compatibility entrypoint exports listClaimAdmissibilityPacks and related types/functions.

edge.desc: Existing proof-admissibility exports remain usable through the same entrypoint.

adversarial.desc: No second proof manager, ledger, storage root, or lifecycle gate export is introduced.

items.title: Add focused smoke coverage for M1 pack registry behavior
items.context: Add a package script and smoke task proving the registry contract, validation, and non-claim boundaries.
items.userSees: Command output ends with: "claim-admissibility pack framework smoke passed".

happy.desc: The focused smoke passes after build and prints the expected final line.

edge.desc: The smoke checks optional benchmark harness absence and not-found resolution.

adversarial.desc: The smoke proves duplicates fail closed and production/scientific truth claims are not exposed by packs.

auditLog.reason: Implemented and verified by commits 9e6b30e8f, 248e32799, and 825646455.
